cause: Verifier erroneously prohibited every augmentation, including the one explicitly admitted supplied BLeRIOT-C publisher_audio_chain pair. Actual 33 train pairs contain 32 original A pairs and 1 C pair; none uses VOICI. All 35 accepted dev pairs have no augmentation.
correction: Require VOICI dev-only flags and no VOICI paths; permit only absent augmentation or an existing BLeRIOT-C variant with publisher_audio_chain type and a source hash different from VOICI. Frozen data, models, inference, scorer and acceptance were not changed.
